excerpts.content:
Launching heze-devnet-3 with [dynamic basefee](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12552) + [shorter slots](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5743) today. Currently the only EL supporting this is ethrex. If you want to get onboarded please test against heze-devnet-3 network and confirm that you can sync to it. I'm going to do 9s slot time in order to ensure that nobody has leftover implementations of the hardcoded values, and that the new values are derived.
